items.question: Trong câu "Three tempting alternatives, and why each fails:", từ "tempting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three tempting alternatives, and why each fails:", what does "tempting" (adjective) mean?
options: hấp dẫn, dễ khiến người ta muốn chọn
optionsEn: attractive, making you want to choose it
items.explanation: tempting /ˈtemp.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): hấp dẫn, dễ khiến người ta muốn chọn. "A tempting option" = một phương án nghe rất hấp dẫn (nhưng có thể có bẫy).
items.explanationEn: tempting /ˈtemp.tɪŋ/ (adjective): attractive, making you want to choose it. "A tempting option" looks attractive, though it may hide a catch.

items.question: Trong câu "Three tempting alternatives, and why each fails:", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three tempting alternatives, and why each fails:", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. Hay dùng: "an alternative to X" = phương án thay cho X.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another possible choice. Common pattern: "an alternative to X".

items.question: Trong câu "Two requests writing at the same moment overwrite each other (a lost update).", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two requests writing at the same moment overwrite each other (a lost update).", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
options: ghi đè lên (làm mất dữ liệu cũ)
optionsEn: to write over and replace existing data
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên (làm mất dữ liệu cũ). Ghi đè làm mất dữ liệu cũ; "overwrite a file" = ghi đè một file.
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (verb): to write over and replace existing data. Overwriting replaces what was there; "overwrite a file".

items.question: Trong câu "Your phone would not see what you added on your laptop, and the user can edit or wipe it.", từ "wipe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your phone would not see what you added on your laptop, and the user can edit or wipe it.", what does "wipe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to clean a surface with a cloth
items.explanation: wipe /waɪp/ (động từ): xóa sạch (dữ liệu). Trong IT, "wipe" là xóa sạch dữ liệu, ví dụ "wipe the disk". Nghĩa thường ngày: lau chùi.
items.explanationEn: wipe /waɪp/ (verb): to erase data completely. In IT, "wipe" means erase completely, e.g. "wipe the disk". Everyday sense: to clean.

items.question: Trong câu "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a firm promise that something will happen
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự bảo đảm. Một nghĩa khác là giấy bảo hành. "Give a guarantee" = đưa ra bảo đảm.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a firm promise that something will happen. Another sense is a product warranty. "Give a guarantee".

items.question: Trong câu "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", từ "survive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", what does "survive" (verb) mean?
options: vẫn còn nguyên sau (một sự kiện)
optionsEn: to continue to exist after an event
items.explanation: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (động từ): vẫn còn nguyên sau (một sự kiện). "Data survives a restart" = dữ liệu vẫn còn sau khi khởi động lại.
items.explanationEn: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (verb): to continue to exist after an event. "Data survives a restart" means it is still there afterwards.

items.question: Trong câu "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
options: đồng thời, xảy ra cùng lúc
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, xảy ra cùng lúc. "Concurrent users/writes" = người dùng/lệnh ghi cùng lúc. Danh từ: concurrency.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent users/writes". Noun: concurrency.

items.question: Trong câu "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A database gives four guarantees at once: data survives restarts, it is shared by every device that calls the API, it handles concurrent writes safely, and it enforces constraints (rules such as "email must be unique") even when the code has a bug.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
options: thực thi, buộc tuân theo (quy tắc)
optionsEn: to make sure a rule is obeyed
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): thực thi, buộc tuân theo (quy tắc). "Enforce a rule/constraint" = bắt buộc tuân thủ một quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make sure a rule is obeyed. "Enforce a rule/constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "That is why the app keeps only two harmless UI preferences in `localStorage` (`todo:lastEmail`, `todo:filter`) and everything that matters in `todo.db`.", từ "harmless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is why the app keeps only two harmless UI preferences in `localStorage` (`todo:lastEmail`, `todo:filter`) and everything that matters in `todo.db`.", what does "harmless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: harmless /ˈhɑːm.ləs/ (tính từ): vô hại. Trái nghĩa: harmful (có hại), sensitive (nhạy cảm).
items.explanationEn: harmless /ˈhɑːm.ləs/ (adjective): causing no damage or risk. Opposites: harmful, sensitive.

items.question: Trong câu "All three are relational databases that speak SQL.", từ "relational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three are relational databases that speak SQL.", what does "relational" (adjective) mean?
options: quan hệ (lưu dữ liệu thành các bảng liên kết)
thuộc về quan hệ giữa người với người
items.explanation: relational /rɪˈleɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): quan hệ (lưu dữ liệu thành các bảng liên kết). "Relational database" = database quan hệ (SQL). Đối lập: NoSQL.
items.explanationEn: relational /rɪˈleɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): storing data in linked tables. "Relational database" (SQL). Contrast: NoSQL.

items.question: Trong câu "Cloud providers sell MySQL and Postgres as managed services (for example AWS RDS and Aurora), so nobody on the team has to patch the database server.", từ "provider" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cloud providers sell MySQL and Postgres as managed services (for example AWS RDS and Aurora), so nobody on the team has to patch the database server.", what does "provider" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a company that supplies a service
items.explanation: provider /prəˈvaɪ.dər/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp (dịch vụ). "Cloud provider" = nhà cung cấp cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
items.explanationEn: provider /prəˈvaɪ.dər/ (noun): a company that supplies a service. "Cloud provider": AWS, Azure, Google Cloud.

items.question: Trong câu "Cloud providers sell MySQL and Postgres as managed services (for example AWS RDS and Aurora), so nobody on the team has to patch the database server.", từ "patch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cloud providers sell MySQL and Postgres as managed services (for example AWS RDS and Aurora), so nobody on the team has to patch the database server.", what does "patch" (verb) mean?
options: khâu miếng vá lên quần áo
vá, cập nhật bản sửa lỗi cho phần mềm
optionsEn: to sew a piece of cloth over a hole
items.explanation: patch /pætʃ/ (động từ): vá, cập nhật bản sửa lỗi cho phần mềm. Danh từ: a security patch (bản vá bảo mật). Nghĩa thường ngày: vá quần áo.
items.explanationEn: patch /pætʃ/ (verb): to update software with fixes. Noun: a security patch. Everyday sense: to mend clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "The course uses SQLite because it has zero setup: no server to install, no password, and the whole database is one file you can open, copy or delete.", từ "setup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The course uses SQLite because it has zero setup: no server to install, no password, and the whole database is one file you can open, copy or delete.", what does "setup" (noun) mean?
options: một cái bẫy, sự gài bẫy
việc cài đặt, thiết lập ban đầu
optionsEn: the work of installing and configuring
items.explanation: setup /ˈset.ʌp/ (danh từ): việc cài đặt, thiết lập ban đầu. Danh từ viết liền "setup"; động từ viết rời "set up". Nghĩa lóng: cái bẫy.
items.explanationEn: setup /ˈset.ʌp/ (noun): the work of installing and configuring. Noun "setup", verb "set up". Informal sense: a trap.

items.question: Trong câu "`PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`: the database hands out `id` 1, 2, 3… and never reuses a number, even after a delete.", từ "hand out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`: the database hands out `id` 1, 2, 3… and never reuses a number, even after a delete.", what does "hand out" (phrase) mean?
options: cấp phát, phát ra (cho từng cái)
optionsEn: to give out, one to each
items.explanation: hand out /hænd aʊt/ (cụm từ): cấp phát, phát ra (cho từng cái). Danh từ "handout" = tài liệu phát tay.
items.explanationEn: hand out /hænd aʊt/ (phrase): to give out, one to each. The noun "handout" is a printed sheet given out.

items.question: Trong câu "`PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`: the database hands out `id` 1, 2, 3… and never reuses a number, even after a delete.", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`: the database hands out `id` 1, 2, 3… and never reuses a number, even after a delete.", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. "Reuse code/connections" = dùng lại code/kết nối.
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Reuse code/connections".

items.question: Trong câu "A to-do without a title is refused.", từ "refuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A to-do without a title is refused.", what does "refuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (động từ): từ chối. Danh từ: refusal. Lưu ý "refuse" (/ˈref.juːs/, danh từ) còn có nghĩa là rác.
items.explanationEn: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (verb): to not accept. Noun: refusal. "Refuse" (/ˈref.juːs/, noun) also means rubbish.

items.question: Trong câu "SQLite builds an index for it automatically, so login lookups are fast.", từ "lookup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQLite builds an index for it automatically, so login lookups are fast.", what does "lookup" (noun) mean?
options: việc tra cứu, tìm kiếm một giá trị
optionsEn: the act of searching for a value
items.explanation: lookup /ˈlʊk.ʌp/ (danh từ): việc tra cứu, tìm kiếm một giá trị. Danh từ viết liền "lookup"; động từ "look up" = tra cứu.
items.explanationEn: lookup /ˈlʊk.ʌp/ (noun): the act of searching for a value. Noun "lookup"; verb "look up".

items.question: Trong câu "Every to-do must belong to a user who exists.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every to-do must belong to a user who exists.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): thuộc về. "Belong to" = thuộc về; "a to-do belongs to a user".
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to be owned by. "Belong to"; "a to-do belongs to a user".

items.question: Trong câu "`CREATE INDEX … ON todos(user_id)`: every to-do query filters by `user_id`, so the index lets the database jump to one user's rows instead of scanning the whole table.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`CREATE INDEX … ON todos(user_id)`: every to-do query filters by `user_id`, so the index lets the database jump to one user's rows instead of scanning the whole table.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
options: chụp ảnh tài liệu bằng máy quét
duyệt qua từng phần tử, quét
optionsEn: to copy a document with a scanner
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt qua từng phần tử, quét. "Full table scan" = quét toàn bảng (chậm). Nghĩa khác: scan tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through every item. "Full table scan" is slow. Other sense: scanning a document.

items.question: Trong câu "Two SQLite quirks you will meet:", từ "quirk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two SQLite quirks you will meet:", what does "quirk" (noun) mean?
options: điểm kỳ quặc, nét riêng khác thường
items.explanation: quirk /kwɜːk/ (danh từ): điểm kỳ quặc, nét riêng khác thường. Một quirk không phải bug, chỉ là điều bất ngờ cần biết.
items.explanationEn: quirk /kwɜːk/ (noun): an unusual feature or habit. A quirk is not a bug, just something surprising to know.

items.question: Trong câu "SQLite ignores foreign keys unless they are switched on, which is why `db.js` runs `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')`.", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQLite ignores foreign keys unless they are switched on, which is why `db.js` runs `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')`.", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (động từ): bỏ qua, không xét tới. Dễ nhầm với "ignorant" (thiếu hiểu biết).
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (verb): to pay no attention to. Do not confuse with "ignorant" (lacking knowledge).

items.question: Trong câu "SQLite ignores foreign keys unless they are switched on, which is why `db.js` runs `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')`.", từ "switch on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQLite ignores foreign keys unless they are switched on, which is why `db.js` runs `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')`.", what does "switch on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: switch on /swɪtʃ ɒn/ (cụm từ): bật lên. Trái nghĩa: switch off. Đồng nghĩa: turn on, enable.
items.explanationEn: switch on /swɪtʃ ɒn/ (phrase): to turn on. Opposite: switch off. Synonyms: turn on, enable.

items.question: Trong câu "The constraints are not decoration.", từ "decoration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The constraints are not decoration.", what does "decoration" (noun) mean?
options: đồ trang trí, thứ chỉ để làm đẹp
optionsEn: something added only to look nice
items.explanation: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đồ trang trí, thứ chỉ để làm đẹp. "Not just decoration" = có tác dụng thật, không chỉ để trưng.
items.explanationEn: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): something added only to look nice. "Not just decoration" means it does real work.

items.question: Trong câu "We tried to break them directly against the database, and each attempt was refused:", từ "attempt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We tried to break them directly against the database, and each attempt was refused:", what does "attempt" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attempt /əˈtempt/ (danh từ): lần thử, sự cố gắng. "Login attempt" = lần thử đăng nhập; "failed attempts" = số lần thử thất bại.
items.explanationEn: attempt /əˈtempt/ (noun): a try. "Login attempt"; "failed attempts".

items.question: Trong câu "Signup never inserts `created_at` or `id`; the defaults fill them in.", từ "insert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Signup never inserts `created_at` or `id`; the defaults fill them in.", what does "insert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: insert /ɪnˈsɜːt/ (động từ): chèn vào, thêm vào (dữ liệu). Trong SQL: "INSERT INTO table". Nghĩa thường: cắm, nhét vào (insert a card).
items.explanationEn: insert /ɪnˈsɜːt/ (verb): to put data into. In SQL: "INSERT INTO table". Everyday: insert a card.

items.question: Trong câu "`ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC`: `created_at` only has whole seconds, so two to-dos added in the same second are ordered by `id` as a tie-breaker.", từ "tie-breaker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC`: `created_at` only has whole seconds, so two to-dos added in the same second are ordered by `id` as a tie-breaker.", what does "tie-breaker" (noun) mean?
options: tiêu chí phân định khi hai bên bằng nhau
ván đấu phụ trong thể thao
optionsEn: a rule that decides between equal items
a bug that breaks a connection
items.explanation: tie-breaker /ˈtaɪˌbreɪ.kər/ (danh từ): tiêu chí phân định khi hai bên bằng nhau. Gốc từ thể thao (loạt đấu phân định); trong sắp xếp là cột phụ.
items.explanationEn: tie-breaker /ˈtaɪˌbreɪ.kər/ (noun): a rule that decides between equal items. From sports (a deciding game); in sorting it is the second column.

items.question: Trong câu "The API does not even admit that to-do 1 exists.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The API does not even admit that to-do 1 exists.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to accept that something is true
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. Nghĩa khác: cho vào (admit to hospital). Danh từ: admission.
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to accept that something is true. Other sense: to let in (admit to hospital). Noun: admission.

items.question: Trong câu "The server log confirms it: `DELETE /api/todos/1 → 404`.", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The server log confirms it: `DELETE /api/todos/1 → 404`.", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show that something is true
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. Danh từ: confirmation. "Confirm an order" = xác nhận đơn hàng.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (verb): to show that something is true. Noun: confirmation. "Confirm an order".

items.question: Trong câu "Look at every query above: the values are never glued into the SQL text.", từ "glue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look at every query above: the values are never glued into the SQL text.", what does "glue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: glue /ɡluː/ (động từ): gắn, ghép dính vào. Danh từ: keo dán. "Glue code" = code nối các phần lại với nhau.
items.explanationEn: glue /ɡluː/ (verb): to join firmly together. Noun: glue. "Glue code" joins parts together.

items.question: Trong câu "They are `?` placeholders, and the values travel separately:", từ "placeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are `?` placeholders, and the values travel separately:", what does "placeholder" (noun) mean?
options: chữ mờ gợi ý trong ô nhập liệu
ký hiệu giữ chỗ, được thay bằng giá trị thật sau
người giữ chức vụ tạm thời
optionsEn: grey hint text in an input box
a marker later replaced by a real value
a person holding a job temporarily
items.explanation: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): ký hiệu giữ chỗ, được thay bằng giá trị thật sau. Trong HTML, placeholder là chữ gợi ý trong ô input; trong SQL là `?` hoặc `$1`.
items.explanationEn: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a marker later replaced by a real value. In HTML it is hint text in an input; in SQL it is `?` or `$1`.

items.question: Trong câu "String concatenation produces this SQL:", từ "concatenation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "String concatenation produces this SQL:", what does "concatenation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concatenation /kənˌkæt.ənˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự nối chuỗi. Động từ: concatenate. Trong JavaScript: dùng dấu + hoặc template string.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "Describe what changes when migrating to Postgres or MySQL, and what migrations and ORMs are for.", what does "migrate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to another country or region
items.explanation: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi (sang hệ thống khác). Danh từ: migration. Nghĩa gốc: di cư.
items.explanationEn: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (verb): to move to another system. Noun: migration. Original sense: people or birds moving.

items.question: Trong câu "Turn a schema into a data dictionary and derive business rules from it.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turn a schema into a data dictionary and derive business rules from it.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
options: rút ra, suy ra (từ nguồn nào đó)
optionsEn: to get something from a source
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): rút ra, suy ra (từ nguồn nào đó). "Derive X from Y" = rút X ra từ Y. Tính từ: derived data (dữ liệu suy ra).
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to get something from a source. "Derive X from Y". Adjective: derived data.

items.question: Trong câu "The habit to keep: whenever a requirement mentions data, ask where it is stored, which rule protects it, and what happens to it when related records are deleted.", từ "habit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The habit to keep: whenever a requirement mentions data, ask where it is stored, which rule protects it, and what happens to it when related records are deleted.", what does "habit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: habit /ˈhæb.ɪt/ (danh từ): thói quen. "Build a habit" = tạo thói quen. Nghĩa hiếm: áo dòng tu.
items.explanationEn: habit /ˈhæb.ɪt/ (noun): something you do regularly. "Build a habit". Rare sense: a monk's robe.
